description: There is no almost disjoint family of infinite subsets of the naturals containing every other almost disjoint family.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.no_greatest_family :
  ¬∃ G,
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.IsAlmostDisjoint G ∧
        ∀ (A : Set (Set ℕ)), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.IsAlmostDisjoint A → A ⊆ G
